description_hook: If this episode sparked your curiosity, leave us a rating — it helps more people discover the show.
script_improvement: End every episode by teasing the next topic and explicitly asking listeners to leave a rating on Spotify to help the show grow.
summary: No real listener data is available yet, so recommendations are based entirely on Spotify best practices rather than performance trends. Defaults are set to encourage early growth through SEO-friendly titles, ratings CTAs, and topic consistency around AI, quantum, and big tech.
